en: Black‑and‑white street scene showing the Hauptstrasse (main street) in a small European town. On the left is a corner building with signage for a confectionery and bakery (Cognitorei, Brot‑Weiss & Fein‑Bäckerei, Café). Next to it stands a larger, more ornate building with signs for the restaurant and dance establishment "Zur Börse" and the name Moritz Henker. Further along the cobblestone street are several gabled houses and timber‑frame buildings, with telegraph poles lining the road. A few people, including children, are visible walking or standing along the street. At the top of the image is printed the caption "Coswig i. Sa. – Hauptstrasse" and a red handwritten number on the right.
